title: Boundary Conditions
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the boundary conditions for the electric field at the surface of the sphere.

title: Force Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must derive the correct expression for the force on the dipole due to the image dipole.

title: Image Dipole Concept
description: Important Criteria: The student should demonstrate understanding of the image dipole method and its application in this problem.

title: Electric Field Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must show the derivation of the electric field produced by the image dipole at the location of the dipole.

title: Units Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common sign mistakes in the force calculation or in the electric field expression.

title: Neglecting Terms
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should not neglect significant terms in the force expression when r is large compared to a.
